Finding usTshikwalo Game Lodge, Dinokeng Game Reserve →
The practicals

Check-in

Friday from 14:00, or Saturday from 11:00. Saturday night is compulsory — we are booking out the whole lodge.

Check-out

Sunday at 10:00, after breakfast.

Dress code

Semi-formal, earth-toned and summery. Please avoid black, white, red and purple.

Food & drink

A cash bar and The Roots restaurant are open all weekend. No outside food or drinks, please.

Getting there

The last stretch is a dirt road, fine for any car. Secure parking at the lodge.

In between

A complimentary game drive for Friday guests, the pool, and the boma and bonfire after the reception.

What it costs
Friday & SaturdayFriday dinner, Friday accommodation, Saturday breakfast, wedding events, Saturday accommodation, Sunday breakfast, complimentary game drive.
R2 100per person
Saturday onlyWedding events, Saturday accommodation, Sunday breakfast.
R965per person
Children 2 to 12Children under 2 stay free.
R270per child per night

Every household's total includes the R100 Dinokeng conservation fee, so there is nothing to pay at the gate. Your total is worked out for you on the RSVP form. Paid by EFT, directly to us, by Friday 16 October 2026 — banking details are on the RSVP form.

Kindly respond by Monday, 28 September 2026.

RSVP now
